correctness_and_structure.frozen_transcript_result: 12/12 Level-I PK/SK/signed-message/post-RNG transcripts byte-identical to the frozen control corpus
correctness_and_structure.focused_sanitizer_result: fixed signed reduction and protected square-root focused ASan+UBSan test passed
correctness_and_structure.full_sign_sanitizer_boundary: full packed Sign reaches a pre-existing mp_invert_matrix/mp_mul dynamic-stack overflow under ASan in both the protected candidate and clean c2a807 control; therefore no full-Sign sanitizer pass is claimed
correctness_and_structure.linked_elf_result: one IRQ-masked GPIO window; no legacy sqrt/pow/div fallback; fixed 521-bit exponent and input-reduction loops; one 4,488-byte workspace clear

primary_segment_firmware.target: RP2350 Cortex-M33 Arm-S, Level-I/RADIX32, Release -O3, 150 MHz
primary_segment_firmware.measured_window: interrupt-masked GPIO window containing exactly one protected 521-round Montgomery exponentiation; context setup, exponent derivation, validation, erasure and serial I/O are outside

timing_result.window: 160/160 operations passed; 62,042..62,053 us for one exponentiation at integer-microsecond resolution
timing_result.interpretation: no strong coarse timing association is resolved in this small public corpus; this is not an equivalence test or an analog result

primary_segment_firmware.claim_boundary: firmware construction, structural ELF evidence and coarse target-reported timing only; exact recovery of its Legendre e=(m-1)/2 would reveal the corresponding modulus as m=2e+1, while mask selection and operand/state switching remain possible analog leakages

integrated_followup_firmware.purpose: repeat any segment-level finding inside one complete protected Cornacchia square root and test composition effects
integrated_followup_firmware.measured_window: one protected modular square root including fixed input reduction and bounded Tonelli-Shanks
integrated_followup_firmware.claim_boundary: integrated timing and structure only; no archived raw power or EM samples

residual_surface_inventory.selector_model: an ideal observation of the source-level all-zero/all-one selector mask recovers all 16 public fixture exponents; this is a leakage hypothesis and structural rejection test, not a physical result

rejected_blinding_design.decision: standalone exponent blinding is rejected; any future randomized candidate must pass the multi-call GCD campaign rather than only a single-pow screen

rejected_selector_masking_design.decision: naive two-share selector masking is rejected because sequential share Hamming distance reveals the bit; future masking must include transition-aware compiler and physical gates

required_masked_montgomery_scope.decision: a future candidate must cover all 18 source-backed secret-reachable values and the outer Tonelli--Shanks composition; six partial scopes are rejected before physical evaluation

masked_arithmetic_prototype_direction.decision: a two-limb functional word-arithmetic oracle now exists; abstract Boolean gadgets pass single-wire marginal checks but fail adjacent-share transition checks, and transition-controlled assembly remains pending

masked_word_functional_prototype.decision: functional/value-model evidence only; five direct adjacent-share HD channels are rejected, zero-precharge passes only an abstract model, and ANALOG-4 remains mandatory

masked_refresh_m33.decision: exact one-word Cortex-M33 assembly, QEMU functionality, a byte-audited RP2350 acquisition image, 12 serial smoke records and a reduced zero-precharge HD model are frozen; no analog traces exist, physical RP2350 leakage remains unknown, and ANALOG-5 is mandatory before reuse

decision_rule.pass: ANALOG-0 controls pass, ANALOG-1A and ANALOG-1B have no exact exponent/input recovery, and ANALOG-2 has no positive primary or control screen in both independent campaigns
decision_rule.fail: any reproducible exact exponent or Cornacchia-input recovery, or positive primary leakage result
decision_rule.inconclusive: failed controls, insufficient traces, unstable acquisition, one-run-only alerts or missing raw/provenance artifacts
decision_rule.deployment_after_pass: still blocked until the positive host full-Sign control/address differences, retries, half-GCD and residual arithmetic surfaces are addressed and the final target is evaluated
decision_rule.future_randomized_candidate: must additionally execute ANALOG-3; a single-call non-recovery or TVLA non-detection cannot approve exponent blinding
decision_rule.future_masked_candidate: must first pass the local ANALOG-5 primitive campaign, cover the complete checked dynamic-modulus Montgomery/Tonelli--Shanks scope, and then execute ANALOG-4 with final-assembly share tracking and transition-aware attacks; secret-independent share marginals or QEMU functionality cannot approve software masking
